je-19gE.title: Houses: pastel walls, dark slate roofs
je-19gE.summary: Buildings look like northern France, with pastel walls and dark slate roofs. British-style terraced houses are common too.

je-1Tin.title: Sign: some signs hang off-centre on the post
je-1Tin.summary: A minority of road signs are attached to the post off-centre. This seems more common here than on the British mainland.

differs.how: Off-centre signs are less common in the UK

je-2Pw0.title: Road lines: yellow give-way lines at junctions
je-2Pw0.summary: Give-way lines at intersections are yellow. The UK normally uses double dotted white lines.

differs.how: UK give-way lines are double dotted white

je-4QYR.title: Road: boundary fence along the airport
je-4QYR.summary: Roads next to the airport have a visible boundary fence.

je-4uA3.title: Coverage: greenish-purple glitch patches
je-4uA3.summary: Photos with a greenish-purple tint in the south-west. The glitch darkens parts of the screen and blends into the scenery. It also happens in other countries.

je-DwPv.title: Plants: Cornish palms, thin trunks, arching leaves
je-DwPv.summary: Palm-like plants with thin trunks and arching leaves, often planted for decoration. They also grow on some stretches of the British coast.

differs.how: Also found on some British coastlines

je-PTyL.title: Landmark: power station chimney on the south coast
je-PTyL.summary: The chimney of a power station on a peninsula south of the capital can be seen from many points along the south coast. Use it to pinpoint.

je-QfN6.title: Plate: white front, yellow rear, no blue strip
je-QfN6.summary: British-style long plates, white at the front and yellow at the back, with a red coat of arms on the left and a J at the start of the code. No blue strip, unlike the UK mainland.

differs.how: UK plates have a blue strip; these have a red coat of arms

je-SnbW.title: Landscape: large treeless area on the west coast
je-SnbW.summary: A vast treeless nature reserve on the west coast, with a gentle slope down to the west and often overcast skies.

je-VFkp.title: Sign: street names with a coat of arms
je-VFkp.summary: Most street name signs carry a small coat of arms of the local parish.

je-VJhc.title: Landscape: urban area with taller buildings
je-VJhc.summary: Around the capital the look turns urban: taller buildings, narrower streets and more activity than the rural rest of the island.

je-Vpg7.title: Road: only divided road, maroon median
je-Vpg7.summary: The only divided road on the island, with a distinct maroon median. It runs along the south coast just west of the capital.

je-WJRF.title: Landscape: winding lanes, hedges, sunny, older camera
je-WJRF.summary: Winding tree-covered lanes with hedgerows like English country roads, mostly sunny. All photos come from the older Gen 2 camera (grainy, dull colours).

je-Y2Eu.title: Sign: UK-style signs and driving on the left
je-Y2Eu.summary: Road signs, chevrons and warning signs look like the UK ones, and traffic drives on the left. Small differences are covered in the other clues.

differs.how: Subtle differences like yellow give-way lines and yellow phone booths

je-gRdF.title: Language: French-sounding street names
je-gRdF.summary: Most street and place names contain French words. The local language Jèrriais, close to French, appears on a few signs.

differs.how: Cars drive on the left and plates are British-style

je-lm-66765.title: Chevron: big yellow outline
je-lm-66765.summary: Chevron signs often have a big yellow outline. Other road signs look like the UK ones and traffic drives on the left.

differs.how: UK chevrons do not usually have a big yellow outline

je-mfYy.title: Sign: Green Lane and blue island-map markers
je-mfYy.summary: Cycling signs mention the start or end of a Green Lane. Blue route markers show a small island map in the centre.

je-r1L7.title: Coverage: small island off a bigger coast
je-r1L7.summary: A self-governing island off the north-west coast of France and a British Crown Dependency. For country streaks it counts as the UK.

je-s918.title: Houses: red granite walls
je-s918.summary: Red granite is a popular building stone, used in many walls and houses across the island.

je-zYT6.title: Phone booth: yellow
je-zYT6.summary: Phone booths are yellow, not the red ones of the UK mainland.
